232.ch: Melvin Moore, Hammond and the New York trip

232.ch: Melvin Moore, Hammond and the New York trip

232.t: Hammond wanted Hobart Banks for Benny Goodman
232.s: Hammond tells Fields he would have given him five thousand dollars for Hobart to replace Teddy Wilson, and later sent Hobart to Cafe Society.
232.ch: Melvin Moore, Hammond and the New York trip

73.q: You know? And, when I walked in I saw alot of people. But then I saw her -- I saw Helen. And she was so busy, and looked so happy, and so friendly, you know what I mean, that she really made an impression on me.

171.q: You know. For an example, when Andy Kirk was winnin' all the battles, when Basie came in and won such acclaim. But he had the right publicity and everything behind him, Basie, you know.
